note: Verdicts partly reflect the conservative heuristic annotator (see summary.aggregate.json instrumentShift). REJECTED/WEAKENED at 160 that align with pilot findings (esp. H3) are the credible ones; those newly weakened only at 160 may be instrument-driven.

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = records with >=2 actions. Sparse eligibility itself is the H11 caveat.
results.claim: behavior actions chain into recurring intra-message transitions (a grammar exists at all)

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = records where a reveal has a following action.
results.claim: reveal is frequently followed by self-devaluation within the same message
results.revisedFormulation: reveal is only sometimes followed by self-devaluation; self-devaluation is one of several continuations, not the default.

results.boundaryCondition: Counterexamples = reveal-without-mask records, reported explicitly to block an overclaim.
results.claim: a reveal is usually masked/retracted right after it (defensive concealment)
results.revisedFormulation: a reveal is NOT usually masked immediately; reveal→vulnerability-management is recurring, but immediate mask is only one of several strategies (reveal-without-mask is common).

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = records with A-grade fear_of_abandonment; tierA+tierB reassurance couplings counted.
results.claim: fear-of-abandonment couples to reassurance-seeking strategies (driver→strategy grammar)

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = low/minimal observed trigger; observed = those also high inferred activation.
results.claim: a low observed trigger co-occurs with high inferred activation (hair-trigger sensitivity)
results.revisedFormulation: low observed trigger co-occurs with high inferred activation in a SUBSET of records; low-trigger + low-activation cases also exist and bound the hair-trigger claim.

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = records with a known coexistence type; 'unknown' excluded (not evidence of rarity).
results.claim: single-valence affect dominates; mixed simultaneous affect is rare

results.boundaryCondition: Top operation observed = seek_exclusivity. H7 asks whether test_bond leads.
results.claim: test_bond is the most frequent relationship operation
results.revisedFormulation: original claim not supported at 160; narrower formulation required (see counterexamples).

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = all records; observed = records with a confident immediate expected-reply class.
results.claim: utterances are designed to elicit a specific partner operation (expected-reply grammar)

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = multi-beat (>=2 action) records; observed = those with an escalation step.
results.claim: multi-beat messages carry an escalation arc more often than not
results.revisedFormulation: multi-beat messages do not reliably escalate; arcs are heterogeneous (escalate / repair / de-escalate all occur).

results.boundaryCondition: Eligible = records where perform_confidence has a following action.
Sparsity is a finding: if most records are single-action, transition grammar needs more data.
results.claim: most records are single-action, so cross-action grammar is sparse at this n (a limitation, stated as a hypothesis to test)
